surat.headline: Mixed trends in Surat as diamond exports rally while textile traders face demand-fire disruptions.
what_changed: Surat diamond units reduced Diwali vacations from 25 to 7 days following a post-holiday demand rally.
Gems and jewellery exports surged 34.01% ahead of Christmas, with LGD exports jumping 96% and natural diamonds up 19%.
Polyester FDY and staple fibre prices dropped by 6.96% and 4.33% respectively due to lower crude oil and freight rates.
Surat weavers requested moving yarn administration from the Chemicals Ministry to the Ministry of Textiles.
stress_signals: Surat textile traders faced fraud worth Rs 43.54 lakh as operators of Veer Creation fled with grey fabric [e15e6b4c5b22].
Textile units and godowns experienced significant disruptions due to major fires, including one blazing past 32 hours [47888fb89bb1, 70735ded426a].
Rising inflation has curbed consumer buying, leading to a broader market slowdown for Surat textile traders [0fed4a76da43].
Lab-grown diamonds are pressuring natural diamond prices and impacting the resale market [3d642383c7eb].
improvement_signals: GJEPC reported a 96% surge in LGD exports and a 19% increase in natural diamond exports [ffee544acb58].
Christmas demand boosted gems and jewellery exports by 34.01%, shortening diamond unit vacations [20dc10f35062, c3b68570a07d].
MANTRA signed innovation MoUs with IIT Gandhinagar and Garden Silk Mills for polymeric yarn development [1afe1286245d, a09df64b91a6].
what_to_watch: Insurance claim settlements and inventory loss assessments for fire-affected textile godowns and units.
Receivables aging and counterparty risk checks among grey fabric traders to spot further default or fraud cases.
